releaseNotes:
IRIS-MX v1.4.3
• New black-and-orange interface, circular animated IRIS portrait and smoother voice waveform.
• Improved background commands, headset routing, voice interruption and optional offline hey iris wake word.
• WhatsApp searches chats and groups directly, replaces old drafts with your latest message and avoids repeated searches and sends.
• India defaults to Hinglish, with saved language preferences, five IRIS voices and a preferred name.
• Added weather, news, stocks, currency and more Android controls.
• Cleaner Settings, targeted permission shortcuts and manufacturer background guides.
• Strengthened paid access and two-phone account protection, in-app policies, session recovery and compatible OTA updates.
